note: Grundy County MO publishes no zoning district layer; its county GIS server (maps.grundyco.org) is Grundy County, Illinois. Trenton, the largest city, publishes its official zoning map only as a PDF (Zoning_36x36.pdf); its Trenton GIS is a Mango web map viewer with a Trenton Zoning layer but no public queryable ArcGIS service was found. No Grundy County or Trenton zoning service on ArcGIS Online or Hub.
